writing.explanation: Top-Down Memoization belongs to 1D Dynamic Programming. Its invariant is the part that stays true after every step; tracing that invariant is more reliable than memorising lines. Typical uses include recursive recurrences with repeated states.
writing.feedback: The invariant explains both correctness and which state may change.
